entities.summary: Oleksii Krutykh is a Ukrainian tennis player. He has a career high ATP singles ranking of World No. 160 achieved on 27 February 2023. 275 achieved on 5 December 2022. He has won two ATP Challenger singles titles and two doubles titles.
